## Pull request overview

This PR fixes CI build errors in the documentation by correcting MDX parsing errors and invalid meta.json structure. Despite the misleading title "[WIP] Add action step for GitHub job", the changes actually address build failures that were preventing successful documentation generation.

**Changes:**
- Fixed MDX table syntax in `ai-development-guide.mdx` by wrapping curly braces in backticks to prevent JSX interpretation
- Flattened nested navigation structure in `meta.json` to match the framework's expected format

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| content/docs/developers/meta.json | Removed nested "AI-Driven Development" object and flattened pages into main array, aligning with meta.json structure used elsewhere |
| content/docs/developers/ai-development-guide.mdx | Wrapped 6 instances of curly braces in backticks within table cells to fix MDX parsing errors |

The PR title "[WIP] Add action step for GitHub job" does not accurately describe the changes in this PR. The actual changes fix CI build errors by correcting MDX syntax and meta.json structure, as documented in the PR description. Consider updating the title to something like "Fix CI build errors in documentation" to accurately reflect the changes made.
